verdict.rationale: macOS ships AI features (Siri AI chat, drafting, screen understanding), so a training-data opt-out is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence documents a control that keeps user data out of AI model training. The only privacy item is a generic mention of password management and private browsing, which is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
